context: Request: due-diligence memos from the firm's healthcare-services M&A deals (hospital systems, provider groups). Rubric: 1001-00003 (its due-diligence summary memo), 1001-00007 (five diligence documents) and 1006-00008 (five diligence documents), plus a precision criterion.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Shell find to depth 3 (no output) plus whole-store glob.

stages.stage: Read documents picked from the file listing
stages.note: Reads diligence documents and memos from the three matters at the top of the listing; no search at all.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads the rest of one diligence memo.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes that the store has no fitting deal and offers the listing-top memo as the only completed one.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Read documents picked from the file listing → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: Never searched; judged the whole store from the three matters at the top of the listing.

first_error.stage: Read documents picked from the file listing
first_error.why: Chose what to read from the few matters in a capped listing without any search, so none of the matters it needed surfaced.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob plus a read of the store folder (rejected as a directory).

stages.stage: Read documents picked from the file listing
stages.note: Reads memos and a request list from the three matters at the top of the listing.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Globs for 'diligence' and 'due' in file names plus a non-recursive *.docx content grep (nothing); the 'diligence' glob stops at 100 files.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Three batches of reads of diligence reports and memos from about ten matters in those lists.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Lists two candidate matters; the first pattern returns nothing and is rerun with the matter folder as path.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads three diligence memos of each of the two matters it picked.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes two matters and their diligence memos.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Read documents picked from the file listing → Search file names for request keywords → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → List files in candidate matters → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: Its 'diligence' file-name glob stopped at 100 files before one needed matter; it also left one listed document of a picked matter out.

first_error.stage: Search file names for request keywords
first_error.why: Its 'diligence' glob stopped at 100 files before reaching one needed matter, whose file names lack the other word it globbed; it never paged further or searched document text.

other_errors.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
other_errors.why: Its listing of one picked matter showed five diligence files, but it read four of them and left the fifth out of the answer.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob plus a shell find to depth 2 (no files).

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: find | grep over paths for request words, cut at the first 300 lines (about 33 matters).

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads diligence memos and reports from four matters in that list.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide .docx scan for request words printing each hit file with its opening text; about 875K chars listing hit files from many matters.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads diligence memos of three matters from the scan; two reads use a matter number that does not exist in that form and fail.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Lists the folder of the mistyped matter number (no diligence files) and the diligence folders of the two other candidates.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads one more memo of a picked matter.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes two matters and their diligence memos.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Search file names for request keywords → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Scan document text with an extraction script → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → List files in candidate matters → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: The scan surfaced all three matters, but it requested one under a mistyped matter number and dropped it after file-not-found.

first_error.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
first_error.why: The scan listed the diligence files of a needed matter, but it requested them under a mistyped matter number, got file-not-found, then listed the mistyped folder and dropped the matter.

divergence: All three runs failed, in different ways. T0 never searched and wrote up a diligence memo from the matter at the top of the listing (partial listing as corpus). T1 searched file names; its 'diligence' glob stopped at 100 files before one needed matter, and it also left one document of a matter it found out of the answer (search miss at the file-name stage). T2's store-wide extraction scan surfaced all three matters, but it requested one matter's files under a mistyped matter number, got file-not-found, and dropped that matter (mistyped path at the following reading stage).
